भृम भृम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. भ्रम्), Ved.
erring, aberration, error, mistake.
भृमल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. perplexed, bewildered.

भृमि, इस्, इस्, इ, [cf. भ्रमि], Ved. whirling
round, wandering about (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

, = भ्रमण-शील), active, quick, ener-
getic (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

, = भ्रामक =
कर्म-निर्वाहक), sprightly, gay; (इस्), m. a
whirlwind, hurricane, high wind, (according to Sāy.
on Ṛg-veda

, either a moving cloud or a
kind of lute); a whirlpool, eddy; (इस्), f., Ved.
quickness, activity, agility.
—भृम्य्-अश्व, अस्, m.,
Ved., N. of a man [cf. भार्म्यश्व].
